title: A table through a door
situation: Bola walks backwards in front, Shim forwards behind, the table between them, through a 90-centimetre doorway in a solid wall. The table is keyed to Bola's keys and their walks share timing, so the grip distance never changes; both bodies must clear the wall.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
